verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Datadog serves a valid llms.txt at docs.datadoghq.com/llms.txt returning HTTP 200 with a canonical entry-point index for docs, which is exactly what an agent-oriented documentation pointer requires. missing for 10: no independent/community corroboration of agents actually consuming this llms.txt successfully, and no evidence of additional agent-oriented doc formats beyond the single llms.txt file.
